copy.headline: Continuous yield across the service day — not a commute-only boat.
copy.body: The same hull rotates through employer plans, spot seats, shared experiences, and private charters. Each layer fills a different clock block so utilization compounds instead of sitting idle between peaks.

layers.title: Employee & campus plans
layers.body: Guaranteed seat-months for employers and campuses — the schedule spine at market per-seat prices. This is the contracted base that makes the day bankable.

layers.title: Open / spot seats
layers.body: Yield-managed seats on leftover commute capacity — same sailings, incremental revenue without incremental hulls.

layers.title: Shared experiences
layers.body: Public sailings in the hours a commute-only vessel wastes — tourism and leisure demand on the same asset.

layers.title: Private charters
layers.body: Hourly group bookings stacked on the same crew day — premium yield between network trips.

copy.bridge: The timeline below shows how those layers land on one vessel clock — then the P&L lets you stress the inputs.
